POLO 2.4.8 — Identity Remaster & Cleanup Center

## NEW

- Cleanup Center joins RAM Lab and Storage Lab with a Discover → Classify → Verify → Preview → Review → Plan → Revalidate → Execute → Verify → Evidence workflow.
- Signed-in POLO use qualifies one Active Day after 60 visible seconds, once per local date, with idempotent offline queueing and a seven-day sync window.
- Missions include a READY view for locally completed or verifying objectives.

## IMPROVED

- POLO ID creation now separates Account, Identity, Privacy and Ready steps.
- Sign in accepts email or POLO handle, ignores a leading @ and normalizes handle case without changing the password.
- Missions use explicit actions: Continue requirement, Connect POLO ID, Retry sync, View streak and View reward.
- Permanent mission cosmetics use unique user/mission/reward transactions so a retry cannot duplicate a grant.
- Cleanup candidates show measured size, file count, risk and excluded linked/protected entries before review.

## FIXED

- Completed 1/1 missions no longer show Continue.
- Sign in no longer requires a new-account 12-character password.
- Account errors now distinguish invalid credentials, unavailable service, timeout, rate limit, expired session, reserved handle and taken handle.

## SECURITY & PRIVACY

- Cleanup Center never sends raw deletion paths from the interface. The native engine issues a five-minute immutable plan and revalidates every exact candidate.
- Reparse points, changed files, out-of-root paths, locked entries and unavailable files are skipped and recorded.
- Large files, duplicates, old installers and app leftovers remain manual/protected; no registry cleaner or Prefetch cleaner was added.
- Cloudflare schema migration 0004 must be applied before deploying the V4 Community Worker.
